title: The Midnight Polka Broadcast
crime_description: The city emergency alert broadcast system was hijacked to loop Bavarian accordion polka for twenty minutes.

suspect.name: Brunhilda Pocketwatch Purveyor
suspect.quirk: Speaks in phrases of exact timing, using words like 'precisely' and 'simultaneously'

dossier.text: Security footage shows a figure with a distinctive pink scarf entering the bunker at 10:14 PM.
The hijacked broadcast system's access logs reveal a login attempt from a device with the IP address 192.168.1.42 at 10:46 PM.
A maintenance worker reports hearing suspicious accordion music coming from the bunker's east wing at 11:16 PM.

truth_timeline.event: Brunhilda prepares tools and sneaks in, precisely timing her entry to avoid security cameras.
Brunhilda executes the micro-crime, simultaneously hijacking the broadcast system and playing the polka.
Brunhilda flees, accidentally dropping a torn piece of her pink scarf near the access console.

lie_plan.cover_story: Brunhilda claims she was at a synchronized swimming competition at the time of the hijacking, and was simply 'simultaneously' watching the broadcast on her phone.

weak_points.claim: Brunhilda claims she was not wearing a pink scarf at the time of the hijacking.
weak_points.planned_slip: Brunhilda 'accidentally' mentions her pink scarf when discussing her swimming uniform.

weak_points.claim: Brunhilda claims the device used to hijack the broadcast system was not her own, but rather a 'borrowed' device from the maintenance team.
weak_points.planned_slip: Brunhilda 'remembers' that she lent her device to the maintenance team for a 'project'.

weak_points.claim: Brunhilda claims she was in the west wing of the bunker at 11:16 PM, and did not hear any music.
weak_points.planned_slip: Brunhilda 'misremembers' the layout of the bunker, and claims she was in the west wing 'at the time'.

solution_contradictions: Brunhilda claimed she was at a synchronized swimming competition, which directly conflicts with fact-1.
Brunhilda claimed the device used to hijack the broadcast system was not her own, which directly conflicts with fact-2.
